test_title: PYST 24: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

In doing so, he have acquainted/ himself with the geological features/ and colours of the stone of the site.

options.text: and colours of the stone of the site.
In doing so, he have acquainted

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** error in the** sentence is in the verb form "he have acquainted". 
 
• In the English language, the third person singular subjects (he, she, it) are followed by has, not have.</li&g
